verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS incorporation service, so the axis applies. Every documented Atlas workflow (the application, signing, SAFEs, payments activation) runs through the Atlas application or Dashboard, and nothing in the evidence shows an Atlas API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404, and llms.txt or markdown docs make the documentation readable to AI but are not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
